title: "Typography"
description: "Typography design tokens for the Cyclone UI (Light Dimmed)."
---

# Typography

6 tokens in the `typography` group.

| Token                  | Type         | Value                                                                                  | CSS Variable                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ---------------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `typography.body`      | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}"}`                      | `--storm-typography-body`      | Running-text face: Storm Sans with snug leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for paragraphs, descriptions and other multi-line reading copy, from dense table rows and sidebars to article body text. Used by BodyText, LinkText and Breadcrumb.                                                                                                                                  |
| `typography.caption`   | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}","fontStyle":"italic"}` | `--storm-typography-caption`   | Supporting-text face: Storm Sans italic with snug leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for secondary, low-emphasis text that annotates something else, such as helper and validation messages, small labels, value readouts and metadata. Used by Field helper and validation text, ValidationText, Badge, Slider value labels, ColorPicker and EyebrowText.                      |
| `typography.code`      | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Google Sans Code","lineHeight":"\{line-height.snug}"}`                | `--storm-typography-code`      | Monospace face: Google Sans Code with snug leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for anything that must keep fixed-width alignment or reads as a literal value, such as source code, file paths, identifiers, keyboard input, card numbers and step counters. Used by CodeBlock, InlineCodeText, FileTree, FilePicker, Stepper, CreditCardInput and code content inside Accordion. |
| `typography.display`   | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Sans","lineHeight":"\{line-height.normal}"}`                    | `--storm-typography-display`   | Default UI display face: Storm Sans with normal leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for headings, labels and other short, prominent UI text such as titles, buttons, tags and toggles. Used by HeadingText (`base` variant, all levels), LabelText, Button, LinkText, Tag, Toggle, Breadcrumb, TypeTable and CodeBlock/CreditCardInput chrome.                                   |
| `typography.editorial` | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Storm Serif","lineHeight":"\{line-height.normal}"}`                   | `--storm-typography-editorial` | Editorial display face: Storm Serif with normal leading. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for long-form, content-led headings such as article, blog and marketing page titles, where a warmer, bookish tone fits better than `display`. Used by HeadingText's `editorial` variant for the larger levels; the smallest levels fall back to `display` for legibility.                    |
| `typography.eyebrow`   | `typography` | `\{"fontFamily":"Google Sans Code","lineHeight":"\{line-height.none}"}`                | `--storm-typography-eyebrow`   | Kicker face: Google Sans Code with no extra leading, so it sits tight against the content below. Size and weight come from the component. Use it for the short, usually uppercase category or section label placed directly above a heading. Used by EyebrowText.                                                                                                                                     |
